claim: Endometrial fibrosis is the leading cause of uterine infertility.
source: Endometrium fibrosis is the leading cause of uterine infertility, but the role of circRNAs in its pathogenesis is largely unknown.
evidence: This is stated in the abstract as a background fact about endometrial fibrosis.

claim: circPTPN12 is upregulated in endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) of fibrotic endometrium.
source: Here, we provide the evidence that upregulation of circPTPN12 in endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) of fibrotic endometrium functions as endogenous sponge of miR-21–5 p to inhibit miR-21–5 p expression and activity, which in turn results in upregulation of ΔNp63α to induce the epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of EECs (EEC–EMT).
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract and supported by experimental data throughout the manuscript.

claim: circPTPN12 functions as an endogenous sponge of miR-21-5p to inhibit miR-21-5p expression and activity.
source: Here, we provide the evidence that upregulation of circPTPN12 in endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) of fibrotic endometrium functions as endogenous sponge of miR-21–5 p to inhibit miR-21–5 p expression and activity, which in turn results in upregulation of ΔNp63α to induce the epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of EECs (EEC–EMT).
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract and supported by luciferase assays, pull-down experiments, and RIP experiments.

claim: Inhibition of miR-21-5p by circPTPN12 results in upregulation of ΔNp63α.
source: Here, we provide the evidence that upregulation of circPTPN12 in endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) of fibrotic endometrium functions as endogenous sponge of miR-21–5 p to inhibit miR-21–5 p expression and activity, which in turn results in upregulation of ΔNp63α to induce the epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of EECs (EEC–EMT).
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract and supported by experimental data showing the regulatory relationship.

claim: Upregulation of ΔNp63α induces epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of EECs.
source: Here, we provide the evidence that upregulation of circPTPN12 in endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) of fibrotic endometrium functions as endogenous sponge of miR-21–5 p to inhibit miR-21–5 p expression and activity, which in turn results in upregulation of ΔNp63α to induce the epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of EECs (EEC–EMT).
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract and supported by previous work cited in the manuscript.

claim: Administration of miR-21-5p reverses circPTPN12-driven EEC-EMT in a mouse model of endometrium fibrosis.
source: In a mouse model of endometrium fibrosis, circPTPN12 appears to be a cofactor of driving EEC–EMT and administration of miR-21–5 p could reverse this process and improve endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the abstract and supported by in vivo mouse experiments.

claim: The dysfunction of circPTPN12/miR-21-5p/ΔNp63α pathway contributes to the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis.
source: Our findings revealed that the dysfunction of circPTPN12/miR-21–5 p/∆Np63α pathway contributed to the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is the main conclusion stated in the abstract, synthesizing the findings of the study.

claim: Endometrial fibrosis is often secondary to severe injury of endometrium including various uterine operations mainly repeated curettage.
source: Endometrial fibrosis is clinically characterized with intrauterine adhesions (IUA) and is often secondary to severe injury of endometrium including various uterine operations mainly repeated curettage.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge in the introduction.

claim: Endometrial fibrosis is the most common reason of uterine infertility.
source: Endometrial fibrosis is the most common reason of uterine infertility (Yu et al., 2008; March, 2011a; March, 2011b).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: The mechanism of endometrial fibrosis remains unclear.
source: The mechanism of endometrial fibrosis remains unclear, which hampers the development of effective therapeutics for the disease (March, 2011b).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: Ectopic expression of ΔNp63α in the endometria of IUA patients triggers EEC-EMT to promote endometrial fibrosis.
source: Recently, our study showed that the ectopic expression of ΔNp63α, a transcription factor, in the endometria of IUA patients triggers the epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT) of endometrial epithelial cells (EECs) (EEC–EMT) to promote endometrial fibrosis (Zhao et al., 2020).
evidence: This is stated as a previous finding from the authors' prior work, supported by citation.

claim: Post-transcriptional regulation has critical roles in the process of EMT.
source: In the process of EMT, post-transcriptional regulation has critical roles (Nieto et al., 2016).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: let-7d is downregulated in EMT of lung epithelial cells.
source: Studies showed that let-7d is downregulated in EMT of the lung epithelial cells and downregulation of let-7d in mice causes lung fibrosis (Pandit et al., 2010).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: Downregulation of let-7d in mice causes lung fibrosis.
source: Studies showed that let-7d is downregulated in EMT of the lung epithelial cells and downregulation of let-7d in mice causes lung fibrosis (Pandit et al., 2010).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: miR-29b suppresses EMT of lung epithelial cells and prevents mice against lung fibrosis.
source: miR-29b suppresses EMT of lung epithelial cells and prevents mice against lung fibrosis (Sun et al., 2019).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: miR-34a induces EMT in renal tubular epithelial cells.
source: In the renal fibrosis, miR-34a induces EMT in renal tubular epithelial cells and knockout miR-34a ameliorates renal fibrosis in mice (Liu et al., 2019a).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: Knockout of miR-34a ameliorates renal fibrosis in mice.
source: In the renal fibrosis, miR-34a induces EMT in renal tubular epithelial cells and knockout miR-34a ameliorates renal fibrosis in mice (Liu et al., 2019a).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: miRNAs may function differently in the pathogenesis of fibrosis in different tissues.
source: Moreover, miRNAs may function differently in the pathogenesis of fibrosis in different tissues.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge and supported by examples in the text.

claim: miR-27a prevents the fibrosis of detrusor and kidney.
source: For example, miR-27a prevents the fibrosis of detrusor and kidney (Wu et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2018), but promotes the myocardial fibrosis (Ya-Se et al., 2018).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: miR-27a promotes myocardial fibrosis.
source: For example, miR-27a prevents the fibrosis of detrusor and kidney (Wu et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2018), but promotes the myocardial fibrosis (Ya-Se et al., 2018).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: The role of miRNAs in the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis is less studied.
source: However, the role of miRNAs in the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis is less studied (Li et al., 2016).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by a citation.

claim: circRNAs are recognized as competing endogenous RNAs (ceRNAs) to sponge miRNAs.
source: circRNAs are recognized as competing endogenous RNAs (ceRNAs) to sponge miRNAs to modulate the expression and activity of miRNAs and their target genes (Li et al., 2018; Zheng et al., 2016; Cheng et al., 2019).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: Little is known about the biological function of circRNAs in the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis.
source: To date, little is known about the biological function of circRNAs in the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge establishing the research gap.

claim: ΔNp63α is regulated by multiple miRNAs.
source: Since we found that the ectopic expression of ΔNp63α in EECs induces EEC–EMT and promotes endometrial fibrosis (Zhao et al., 2020), and ΔNp63α is regulated by multiple miRNAs (Candi et al., 2015; Lena et al., 2008; Rodriguez Calleja et al., 2016), we speculated whether circRNAs is involved in the pathogenesis of endometrial fibrosis by interacting with miRNAs.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: 56 miRNAs were upregulated and 150 were downregulated in IUA patients compared with normal controls.
source: With the significance threshold of absolute mean fold change > 2 and p-values<0.05, of 1681 detectable miRNAs in total, 56 were upregulated and 150 were downregulated in IUA patients, compared with those in normal controls (Figure 1A and Supplementary file 1).
evidence: This is a primary finding from high-throughput sequencing analysis, supported by data shown in Figure 1A.

claim: The expressive abundance of miR-21-5p was the highest in endometria of normal controls.
source: The expressive abundance of miR-21–5 p was the highest in endometria of normal controls but was significantly downregulated in IUA patients (Supplementary file 2).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the sequencing data analysis.

claim: miR-21-5p was significantly downregulated in IUA patients.
source: The expressive abundance of miR-21–5 p was the highest in endometria of normal controls but was significantly downregulated in IUA patients (Supplementary file 2).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the sequencing data analysis.

claim: The 3'-UTR of ΔNp63α has miR-21-5p binding sites.
source: Interestingly, we found that the 3′-UTR of ΔNp63α has miR-21–5 p binding sites by prediction in Microrna.org database.
evidence: This is stated as a finding from bioinformatics prediction.

claim: miR-21-5p expression decreased in endometria of IUA patients.
source: Thus, we tested the expression change of miR-21–5 p ex vivo and confirmed the decrease of miR-21–5 p expression in endometria of IUA patients (Figure 1C), which was further proved by RNA-scope assay (Figure 1D).
evidence: This is a primary finding confirmed by qRT-PCR and RNA-scope assay, shown in Figures 1C and 1D.

claim: miR-21-5p was mainly expressed in EECs.
source: Meanwhile, RNA-scope assay showed that miR-21–5 p was mainly expressed in EECs (Figure 1D).
evidence: This is a primary finding from RNA-scope assay shown in Figure 1D.

claim: Epithelial cells often switch to matrix-producing myofibroblasts via EMT in tissue fibrosis process.
source: Since epithelial cells often switch to matrix-producing myofibroblasts via EMT in tissue fibrosis process (Iwano et al., 2002; Zeisberg et al., 2007) and we proved recently that ΔNp63α inducing EEC–EMT participates in endometrium fibrosis in IUA patients (Zhao et al., 2020), we speculated that miR-21–5 p may serve as a protector for maintaining endometrium homeostasis and preventing EECs from EMT.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: miR-21-5p knockdown downregulated E-cadherin expression in EECs.
source: After miR-21–5 p knockdown, the expression of epithelium-specific marker, E-cadherin, was downregulated, but mesenchymal markers, N-cadherin, α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA), and fibronectin (FN), were overexpressed in EECs (Figure 1E).
evidence: This is a primary finding from loss-of-function experiments shown in Figure 1E.

claim: miR-21-5p knockdown upregulated N-cadherin, α-SMA, and fibronectin expression in EECs.
source: After miR-21–5 p knockdown, the expression of epithelium-specific marker, E-cadherin, was downregulated, but mesenchymal markers, N-cadherin, α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA), and fibronectin (FN), were overexpressed in EECs (Figure 1E).
evidence: This is a primary finding from loss-of-function experiments shown in Figure 1E.

claim: Overexpression of miR-21-5p decreased the expression of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN in EECs.
source: In contrast, overexpression of miR-21–5 p markedly decreased the expression of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN and increased the expression of E-cadherin (Figure 1F).
evidence: This is a primary finding from gain-of-function experiments shown in Figure 1F.

claim: Overexpression of miR-21-5p increased E-cadherin expression in EECs.
source: In contrast, overexpression of miR-21–5 p markedly decreased the expression of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN and increased the expression of E-cadherin (Figure 1F).
evidence: This is a primary finding from gain-of-function experiments shown in Figure 1F.

claim: 17,134 distinct circRNAs were detected in endometrium samples.
source: We detected 17,134 distinct circRNAs and 4886 of them have been registered in circBase database (Figure 2—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: This is a primary finding from high-throughput sequencing analysis.

claim: 4886 detected circRNAs have been registered in circBase database.
source: We detected 17,134 distinct circRNAs and 4886 of them have been registered in circBase database (Figure 2—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: This is a primary finding from high-throughput sequencing analysis.

claim: 4832 circRNAs derived from protein-coding exons.
source: We annotated these circRNAs and found that 4832 of them derived from protein-coding exons (Figure 2—figure supplement 1B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from bioinformatics annotation.

claim: 263 circRNAs were upregulated and 195 were downregulated in IUA patients compared with controls.
source: With the criteria of absolute mean fold change > 2.0 and p-values<0.05. The results showed that there were 263 upregulated circRNAs and 195 downregulated circRNAs (Figure 2—figure supplement 1C).
evidence: This is a primary finding from high-throughput sequencing analysis.

claim: 172 circRNAs have binding sites for miR-21-5p.
source: Then, we predicted circRNAs with binding sites for miR-21–5 p based on miRanda database, and found that there were 172 candidate circRNAs (Figure 2—figure supplement 1D and Supplementary file 3).
evidence: This is a finding from bioinformatics prediction.

claim: Of the 172 miR-21-5p binding circRNAs, 12 were upregulated and 4 were downregulated in IUA patients.
source: Of the 172 miR-21–5 p binding circRNAs, 12 were upregulated and 4 were downregulated in IUA patients (Figure 2A,B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from data analysis shown in Figures 2A and 2B.

claim: hsa_circ_0003764 was the most upregulated circRNA, 64-fold higher than in controls.
source: The most upregulated circRNA was hsa_circ_0003764 (circBase ID), and it was 64-fold higher than that in controls (Figure 2B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from sequencing data shown in Figure 2B.

claim: hsa_circ_0003764 was significantly upregulated in the endometria of IUA patients.
source: qRT-PCR (Figure 2C) and RNA-scope assay (Figure 2D) showed that hsa_circ_0003764 was significantly upregulated in the endometria of IUA patients and mainly expressed in EECs.
evidence: This is a primary finding confirmed by qRT-PCR and RNA-scope assay shown in Figures 2C and 2D.

claim: hsa_circ_0003764 was mainly expressed in EECs.
source: qRT-PCR (Figure 2C) and RNA-scope assay (Figure 2D) showed that hsa_circ_0003764 was significantly upregulated in the endometria of IUA patients and mainly expressed in EECs.
evidence: This is a primary finding from RNA-scope assay shown in Figure 2D.

claim: hsa_circ_0003764 is derived from exons 5 to 8 of PTPN12 gene.
source: Through circPrimer software, we found that hsa_circ_0003764 is derived from 5 to 8 exons of tyrosine–protein phosphatase non-receptor type 12 (PTPN12) gene.
evidence: This is a finding from bioinformatics analysis using circPrimer software.

claim: PTPN12 expression was significantly decreased after RNase R treatment while circPTPN12 expression was not changed.
source: To investigate the stability of circPTPN12, total RNA isolated from IUA patients' endometria was treated with RNase R for 15 min, then the expression of circPTPN12 and PTPN12 was respectively detected and the results showed that PTPN12 expression was significantly decreased while circPTPN12 expression was not changed (Figure 2G).
evidence: This is a primary finding from RNase R resistance assay shown in Figure 2G.

claim: The half-life of circPTPN12 was exceeding 24 hr.
source: Furthermore, we added actinomycin D to inhibit the transcription of EECs. We harvested total RNA at five time points, analyzed the expression of circPTPN12 and PTPN12 by qRT-PCR, and revealed that the half-life of circPTPN12 was exceeding 24 hr, whereas the half-life of linear PTPN12 transcript was less than 4 hr (Figure 2H).
evidence: This is a primary finding from actinomycin D treatment experiment shown in Figure 2H.

claim: The half-life of linear PTPN12 transcript was less than 4 hr.
source: Furthermore, we added actinomycin D to inhibit the transcription of EECs. We harvested total RNA at five time points, analyzed the expression of circPTPN12 and PTPN12 by qRT-PCR, and revealed that the half-life of circPTPN12 was exceeding 24 hr, whereas the half-life of linear PTPN12 transcript was less than 4 hr (Figure 2H).
evidence: This is a primary finding from actinomycin D treatment experiment shown in Figure 2H.

claim: circPTPN12 was more stable than PTPN12 mRNA.
source: Thus, circPTPN12 was more stable than PTPN12 mRNA, suggesting that circPTPN12 is circular.
evidence: This is an inference from the half-life experiments.

claim: circPTPN12 was mainly distributed in the cytoplasm of EECs.
source: Separation analysis of nuclear and cytoplasm showed that circPTPN12 was mainly distributed in the cytoplasm of EECs (Figure 2I).
evidence: This is a primary finding from subcellular fractionation shown in Figure 2I.

claim: circPTPN12 was negatively correlated with miR-21-5p.
source: The results showed that circPTPN12 was negatively correlated with miR-21–5 p (Figure 2J).
evidence: This is a primary finding from correlation analysis shown in Figure 2J.

claim: miR-21-5p was pulled down by circPTPN12.
source: We used biotin-labeled circPTPN12 to pull down the circPTPN12 in the lysates of the transfected HEK-293T cells. The electrophoresis showed that miR-21–5 p was pulled down by circPTPN12 (Figure 3B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from RNA pull-down assay shown in Figure 3B.

claim: Luciferase activity was substantially reduced in the presence of miR-21-5p mimic.
source: Luciferase activity was substantially reduced in the presence of the miR-21–5 p mimic, which was effectively restored when miR-21–5 p was knockdown (Figure 3C).
evidence: This is a primary finding from luciferase reporter assay shown in Figure 3C.

claim: circPTPN12 contains three putative target sites of miR-21-5p.
source: We then compared the sequence of circPTPN12 with that of miR-21–5 p using circBank and Circular RNA Interactome databases and noticed that circPTPN12 contains three putative target sites of miR-21–5 p (Figure 3D, top).
evidence: This is a finding from bioinformatics prediction shown in Figure 3D.

claim: Only the third binding site of circPTPN12 was validated to have the capacity of binding miR-21-5p.
source: The test of delete mutations of each or all of three putative binding sites showed that only the third site was validated to have the capacity of binding by the luciferase assay (Figure 3D, bottom).
evidence: This is a primary finding from deletion mutation luciferase assays shown in Figure 3D.

claim: The precipitates of HEK-293T cell lysates stably expressing Flag-AGO2 contained both miR-21-5p and circPTPN12.
source: The RIP experiment showed that the precipitates of HEK-293T cell lysates stably expressing Flag-AGO2 or Flag-GFP contained not only miR-21–5 p, but also circPTPN12 (Figure 3F), indicating the bind of circPTPN12 and miR-21–5 p.
evidence: This is a primary finding from RIP experiment shown in Figure 3F.

claim: miR-21-5p was colocalized with circPTPN12 in the cytoplasm of Ishikawa cell.
source: Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) demonstrated that miR-21–5 p was colocalized with circPTPN12 in the cytoplasm of Ishikawa cell (Figure 3G).
evidence: This is a primary finding from FISH experiment shown in Figure 3G.

claim: circPTPN12 overexpression decreased the miR-21-5p level in primary EECs.
source: Importantly, qRT-PCR confirmed that circPTPN12 overexpression decreased the miR-21–5 p level in primary EECs (Figure 3H).
evidence: This is a primary finding from overexpression experiment shown in Figure 3H.

claim: Overexpression of circPTPN12 enhanced protein abundance of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN, but decreased E-cadherin in EECs.
source: Meanwhile, compared with that of adenovirus containing no circPTPN12 (Ad-control), overexpression of circPTPN12 enhanced protein abundance of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN, but decreased the level of E-cadherin in EECs (Figure 3I).
evidence: This is a primary finding from overexpression experiment shown in Figure 3I.

claim: Re-transfection with miR-21-5p mimic reversed the pro-EMT effect of circPTPN12 overexpression.
source: While re-transfected with miR-21–5 p mimic reversed this phenomenon with upregulated E-cadherin expression and downregulated N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN expression (Figure 3J).
evidence: This is a primary finding from rescue experiment shown in Figure 3J.

claim: Transfection with miR-21-5p mimic significantly reduced luciferase activity in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αwild plasmid.
source: In line with the prediction, transfection with miR-21–5 p mimic significantly reduced luciferase activity in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αwild plasmid, whereas knockout of miR-21–5 p in ΔNp63αwild HEK-293T cells enhanced the luciferase activity; however, these effects were not observed in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αmut plasmid (Figure 4B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from luciferase reporter assay shown in Figure 4B.

claim: Knockout of miR-21-5p in ΔNp63αwild HEK-293T cells enhanced luciferase activity.
source: In line with the prediction, transfection with miR-21–5 p mimic significantly reduced luciferase activity in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αwild plasmid, whereas knockout of miR-21–5 p in ΔNp63αwild HEK-293T cells enhanced the luciferase activity; however, these effects were not observed in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αmut plasmid (Figure 4B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from luciferase reporter assay shown in Figure 4B.

claim: miR-21-5p mimic remarkably downregulated the mRNA and protein of ΔNp63α in ΔNp63α+ EECs.
source: We used primary EECs transfected with the miR-21-mimic or inhibitor for 48 hr following infection with recombinant adenovirus containing ΔNp63α (Ad-ΔNp63α) and empty vector (Ad-CTL), respectively, and found that miR-21–5 p mimic remarkably downregulated the mRNA and protein of ΔNp63α in ΔNp63α + EECs (Figure 4C,D).
evidence: This is a primary finding from experiments shown in Figures 4C and 4D.

claim: miR-21-5p inhibitor upregulated ΔNp63α protein level in ΔNp63α+ EECs.
source: And the miR-21–5 p inhibitor upregulated ΔNp63α protein level in ΔNp63α + EECs (Figure 4E).
evidence: This is a primary finding from experiment shown in Figure 4E.

claim: Upregulation of circPTPN12 increased luciferase activity in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αwild plasmids.
source: Meanwhile, upregulation of circPTPN12 increased luciferase activity in HEK-293T cells transfected with ΔNp63αwild plasmids, while no luciferase activity change was observed when HEK-293T transfected with ΔNp63αmut plasmids (Figure 4F).
evidence: This is a primary finding from luciferase reporter assay shown in Figure 4F.

claim: Upregulation of circPTPN12 counteracted the inhibitory effect of miR-21-5p on ΔNp63α expression.
source: Moreover, the upregulation of circPTPN12 counteracted the inhibitory effect of miR-21–5 p on ΔNp63α expression (Figure 4G).
evidence: This is a primary finding from experiment shown in Figure 4G.

claim: miR-21-5p mimic remitted ΔNp63α-induced EEC-EMT.
source: And that we revealed that miR-21–5 p mimic remitted ΔNp63α-induced EEC–EMT, upregulated E-cadherin and downregulated N-cadherin and α-SMA at both the mRNA and protein levels (Figure 4H,I).
evidence: This is a primary finding from experiments shown in Figures 4H and 4I.

claim: Upregulation of circPTPN12 counteracted the reversal effect of miR-21-5p on ΔNp63α-induced EMT in EECs.
source: Furthermore, upregulation of circPTPN12 counteracted the reversal effect of miR-21–5 p on ΔNp63α-induced EMT in EECs (Figure 4J).
evidence: This is a primary finding from experiment shown in Figure 4J.

claim: Mouse does not express circPTPN12.
source: Based on circBase and circBank database, mouse does not express circPTPN12, which provided us an opportunity to test the role of circPTPN12 in the pathogenesis of endometrium fibrosis by intrauterine injection of a circPTPN12-containing recombinant adeno-associated virus with a green label (AAV-circPTPN12).
evidence: This is stated based on database information.

claim: AAV-circPTPN12 infected the mouse endometrium.
source: The green fluorescence in mouse endometria was clearly observed after four estrous cycles following virus injection (Figure 5—figure supplement 1C), indicating that AAV-circPTPN12 infected the mouse endometrium.
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5—figure supplement 1C.

claim: AAV-circPTPN12 injection increased circPTPN12 levels in mouse endometria.
source: We further validated the increased circPTPN12 levels in the endometria by qRT-PCR (Figure 5A).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5A.

claim: With the increase of circPTPN12 expression, the expression of miR-21-5p decreased significantly in mouse endometria.
source: With the increase of circPTPN12 expression, the expression of miR-21–5 p decreased significantly (Figure 5B).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5B.

claim: Mice injected with AAV-circPTPN12 showed increased mRNA levels of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN and decreased mRNA level of E-cadherin.
source: Furthermore, the mice injected with AAV-circPTPN12 showed increased mRNA levels of N-cadherin, α-SMA, and FN and decreased mRNA level of E-cadherin, compared with those injected with adeno-associated virus with empty vector (Figure 5C).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5C.

claim: AAV-circPTPN12 injection clearly reduced E-cadherin expression in EECs and remarkably upregulated N-cadherin and α-SMA in both epithelial and stroma cells.
source: Immunohistochemical staining displayed that AAV-circPTPN12 injection clearly reduced E-cadherin expression in EECs and remarkably upregulated N-cadherin and α-SMA in both epithelial and stroma cells (Figure 5D).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5D.

claim: ΔNp63α mRNA was significantly upregulated after AAV-circPTPN12 administration.
source: ΔNp63α mRNA was also significantly upregulated after AAV-circPTPN12 administration (Figure 5E).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5E.

claim: agomir-21-5p application significantly increased E-cadherin and reduced N-cadherin and α-SMA in both luminal and glandular epithelia.
source: Immunohistochemical results showed that agomir-21–5 p application significantly increased E-cadherin and reduced N-cadherin and α-SMA in both luminal and glandular epithelia and reduced Masson staining compared with agomir-NC injection (Figure 5H).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5H.

claim: agomir-21-5p application reduced Masson staining compared with agomir-NC injection.
source: Immunohistochemical results showed that agomir-21–5 p application significantly increased E-cadherin and reduced N-cadherin and α-SMA in both luminal and glandular epithelia and reduced Masson staining compared with agomir-NC injection (Figure 5H).
evidence: This is a primary finding from in vivo experiment shown in Figure 5H.

claim: In normal endometrium, the high level of miR-21-5p in EECs inhibits ΔNp63α expression to maintain the homeostasis of EECs.
source: In the present study, we revealed that in normal endometrium, the high level of miR-21–5 p in EECs inhibits ΔNp63α expression to maintain the homeostasis of EECs, and in the pathological circumstance, circPTPN12 is highly expressed, which decreases miR-21–5 p level in EECs, so the suppression effect of miR-21–5 p on the expression of ΔNp63α is counteracted, leading to EEC–EMT and endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is a summary conclusion synthesizing the findings of the study.

claim: In pathological circumstances, circPTPN12 is highly expressed, which decreases miR-21-5p level in EECs.
source: In the present study, we revealed that in normal endometrium, the high level of miR-21–5 p in EECs inhibits ΔNp63α expression to maintain the homeostasis of EECs, and in the pathological circumstance, circPTPN12 is highly expressed, which decreases miR-21–5 p level in EECs, so the suppression effect of miR-21–5 p on the expression of ΔNp63α is counteracted, leading to EEC–EMT and endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is a summary conclusion synthesizing the findings of the study.

claim: The suppression effect of miR-21-5p on the expression of ΔNp63α is counteracted by circPTPN12, leading to EEC-EMT and endometrial fibrosis.
source: In the present study, we revealed that in normal endometrium, the high level of miR-21–5 p in EECs inhibits ΔNp63α expression to maintain the homeostasis of EECs, and in the pathological circumstance, circPTPN12 is highly expressed, which decreases miR-21–5 p level in EECs, so the suppression effect of miR-21–5 p on the expression of ΔNp63α is counteracted, leading to EEC–EMT and endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is a summary conclusion synthesizing the findings of the study.

claim: ΔNp63α promotes the expression of SNAI1 by DUSP4/GSK3B pathway and induces EEC-EMT and endometrial fibrosis.
source: Previously, we observed that ΔNp63α is ectopically expressed in EECs in IUA patients (Zhao et al., 2017), and showed that ΔNp63α promotes the expression of SNAI1 by DUSP4/GSK3B pathway and induces EEC–EMT and endometrial fibrosis (Zhao et al., 2020).
evidence: This is stated as a previous finding from the authors' prior work, supported by citations.

claim: Transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells into the uterine cavity has therapeutic effect on endometrial fibrosis.
source: These findings are in agreement with the therapeutic effect of transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells into the uterine cavity (Cao et al., 2018).
evidence: This is stated as supporting evidence from a cited study.

claim: Sufficient abundance of miRNAs transcripts in cells is essential in regulating target genes.
source: Since miRNAs are main regulator of ΔNp63α (Candi et al., 2015; Lena et al., 2008; Rodriguez Calleja et al., 2016) and sufficient abundance of miRNAs transcripts in cells is essential in the regulating target genes (Liu et al., 2019a; Brown and Naldini, 2009), we chose the highest expressed miR-21–5 p in normal endometria to study its role in the current study.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge supported by citations.

claim: miR-21-5p is essential in maintaining EECs properties.
source: In IUA mice model, supplementation of exogenous miR-21–5 p reversed the EEC–EMT and endometrial fibrosis, indicating that miR-21–5 p is essential in maintaining EECs properties.
evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the in vivo mouse experiments.

claim: In lung and kidney fibrosis, miR-21-5p promotes EMT.
source: Our findings appear to be different from the observations that in lung and kidney fibrosis researches miR-21–5 p promotes EMT (Liu et al., 2019b; Wang et al., 2019; Luo et al., 2019; Liu et al., 2019c).
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge from cited studies.

claim: miR-21-5p may play different roles in different tissues.
source: Thus, we consider that miR-21–5 p may play different roles in different tissues, which merits further study.
evidence: This is a speculation based on comparing findings across different tissue types.

claim: CircRNAs play critical roles in the pathogenesis of lung/renal/liver fibrosis.
source: CircRNAs are important regulators of miRNAs and play critical roles in the pathogenesis of lung/renal/liver fibrosis.
evidence: This is stated as background knowledge.

claim: This study is the first to demonstrate the role of a circRNA in endometrial fibrosis.
source: Therefore, the current study for the first time demonstrates the role of a circRNA in endometrial fibrosis.
evidence: This is stated as a claim about the novelty of the study.

claim: The IUA patients enrolled in this study were all associated with repeated curettage.
source: First, since the IUA patients enrolled in this study were all associated with repeated curettage, the findings in the present study may not be applicable to the IUA patients associated with infection or uterine artery embolization.
evidence: This is stated as a limitation of the study.

claim: The findings may not be applicable to IUA patients associated with infection or uterine artery embolization.
source: First, since the IUA patients enrolled in this study were all associated with repeated curettage, the findings in the present study may not be applicable to the IUA patients associated with infection or uterine artery embolization.
evidence: This is stated as a limitation of the study.

claim: There may be other less-expressed miRNAs and circRNAs potentially associated with endometrial fibrosis.
source: Second, we only studied the roles of miR-21–5 p and circPTPN12 based on their highest expressions in the heatmap or volcano plots, yet there may be other less-expressed miRNAs and circRNAs that are potentially associated with the endometrial fibrosis, which remains to be further studied.
evidence: This is stated as a limitation and area for future research.
